title: A Direct Proof of Optimal Max-Cut Hardness
summary: We prove that approximating Max-Cut on simple unweighted graphs within any fixed factor greater than the Goemans–Williamson constant is NP-hard.
family_title: The Unique Games Conjecture and optimal approximation thresholds

review.reason: Proves NP-hardness of approximating Max-Cut beyond the Goemans-Williamson constant.
